lifecycle_transition.basis: The commission at workstreams/po03/COMMISSION.md was read in full at the immutable branch head together with every seeded contract, validator and test before any action was taken. Execution began immediately; no plan or acknowledgement was returned.

runtime_binding.prestaged_handle_disposition: NOT_THE_EXECUTING_RUN — runtime-binding divergence recorded as evidence, not a commission change
runtime_binding.authority_note: No authority is claimed from Cursor. The runtime is a binding and an execution surface only.

seeded_controls_state.note: The amendment says strengthen these controls, do not bypass them. They are unmodified; strengthening is additive via control_plane.py, its tests and cohort-owned modules.

durable_sink_proof.method: Committed and pushed the control plane and all 74 dispatch records, then fetched the branch and re-read the ledger blob from the remote object store by immutable SHA.

child_canary_roundtrip.method: Each of the ten isolated worktrees wrote a synthetic canary through the control plane and independently read it back, comparing the written and re-read digests.

hard_precondition_satisfied_before_any_d.conclusion: A durable sink exists and every child can write and independently read back through it, so material work was delegable through this route.

wave_a_dispatch.isolation_mechanism: One background Cursor subagent per cohort, each bound to an exclusive git worktree and an exclusive branch, with a disjoint owned subtree enforced at ingestion by the controller.

concurrency_observed.note: Ten concurrent background subagents were accepted with zero provider rejection, so no ceiling was observed at that level. This is a measured floor on available concurrency, not a claim about the true ceiling.

cohort_allocation.function: portable runtime, clean-clone reproduction and CI enforcement
research to reproduction to live mechanism change
independent adversarial evaluation of Claude-produced work
successor generation compilation and measured comparison
zero-base strategy challenge, alternatives and open discovery
independent adversarial evaluation of GPT-produced work and of the coordinator

standing_functions_staffed.concurrency_note: All ten functions are staffed simultaneously. Current-plan execution runs in parallel with strategy, research, reproduction, evaluation and successor functions rather than after them.

po01_non_interference.read_access_used: Read-only observation only, for pinning immutable SHAs. Cohorts a4 and a10 are instructed to use read-only git operations exclusively and to produce isolated PO-03 repair candidates rather than in-place repairs.

defect_found_and_repaired_before_first_r.subject: allowlist path normalisation in workstreams/po03/tools/control_plane.py
defect_found_and_repaired_before_first_r.found_by: coordinator's own custody test suite, before any subordinate result arrived
defect_found_and_repaired_before_first_r.defect: Normalisation used lstrip('./'), which removes every leading dot and slash rather than a leading './' segment. It wrongly rejected .github/workflows/po03-*.yml, the only workflow prefix the commission permits, and wrongly accepted a leading traversal such as './../packs/x' because stripping ran before the '..' check.
defect_found_and_repaired_before_first_r.repair: Normalisation now refuses any absolute, empty, or '.'/'..'-containing path instead of repairing it, preserves a leading dot in a real name, and is shared by ownership checking so a traversal cannot be folded into an owned subtree.

verification_at_activation.composition: 23 seeded contract tests retained unmodified plus 39 new custody tests
verification_at_activation.path_scope_check: PASS — every changed path inside workstreams/po03/**, receipts/po03/** or .github/workflows/po03-*.yml

outcome_vocabulary_note: Only PASS, FAIL, NOT_YET, NOT_SUPPORTED and OWNER_BLOCKED are used, with exact evidence for every non-PASS outcome.
wave_b_state: NOT_YET — gated on Wave A demonstrating zero false completion, zero result loss and zero path collision
